items.title: Cohen-Macaulay morphisms of schemes are exactly the flat morphisms with Cohen-Macaulay fibres
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma records the equivalence between being a Cohen-Macaulay morphism and being flat with Cohen-Macaulay fibres, for a morphism of schemes whose fibres are locally Noetherian. The proof is recorded in a single line, so the content is the definitional identification rather than any construction; it is retained because the statement is the reference criterion other results invoke. Retained author proof at lines 5842-5844.
